title: Can Claude Opus 5.5 beat Stockfish 2000?
alternatives: Claude Opus 5.5 vs Stockfish 2000: no legal-move hints

context: In our first chess experiment, Claude beat Stockfish set to 1500. This time we raise it to 2000, keeping the same model, side, tools and engine thinking time.
